This variant includes a camera patch for Canon 7D picture-style footage; that patch is byte-for-byte the same LUT as the 5D patch, so it behaves identically and reads as designed on most ordinary Rec.709 clips.
use_for: Dramatic B&W portraits of leaders or protagonists
Moody landscape shots with dark skies
avoid: Foliage turns near-black
Capped highlights make the frame look dim

cards.name: SL Noir Tri-X (Canon 7D)

This variant includes a camera patch for Canon 7D picture-style footage; that patch is byte-for-byte the same LUT as the 5D patch, so it behaves identically and reads as designed on most ordinary Rec.709 clips.
use_for: Photojournalistic B&W for protests, rallies and street footage
avoid: No grain is added: add Noise for the full film look

cards.name: SL Retro Brown (Canon 7D)
cards.summary: 1970s retro grade: a brown-orange cast through shadows and mids with near-neutral (very slightly cool) highlights; blues and greens are darkened heavily (blue objects go near-black navy), skies and yellows are muted, and reds and skin keep their colour; a warm, dated-print feel. This variant includes a camera patch for Canon 7D picture-style footage; that patch is byte-for-byte the same LUT as the 5D patch, so it behaves identically and reads as designed on most ordinary Rec.709 clips.
avoid: Brown shadows look muddy on dark footage
Blue clothing, blue logos and skies go very dark or dull

cards.name: SL Blue Cold (Canon C300)
cards.summary: Bright, high-key cold grade: mids strongly lifted, highlights clip early, and shadows and mids take a cyan-blue cast; every colour except blue is paled and desaturated (yellows, skies and foliage most, skin moderately), giving a washed, wintry look. Its tone curve is almost the same as Blue Steel. This variant includes a camera patch for Canon C300 Canon Log (C-Log) footage. On ordinary Rec.709 footage the C-Log patch over-brightens (a 45% grey lands about 10-15 points brighter than with the 5D/7D variant: near 77% with Blue Cold, 68% with Blue Ice), crushes the deepest shadows and over-saturates, so use it only on C-Log clips and pick the 5D or 7D variant for normal footage.
use_for: Clinical hospital or lab B-roll in a health explainer
Sterile 'cold reality' half of a promise-vs-reality political comparison
avoid: Clips bright skies and white kurtas: pull Highlights down first
Expects C-Log: on normal Rec.709 footage it blows out and over-saturates

cards.name: SL Blue Ice (Canon C300)
